overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the board gave the employee the opportunity to attend with counsel and was not required to postpone the executive session for the attorney's scheduling request.

allegations.summary: A former employee alleged the board fired her in a Purpose 1 executive session without letting her attend with counsel.
allegations.key_passage: The Law requires only that the Board provide Ms. Daley with the opportunity to be present and have counsel attend.

allegations.summary: The employee's attorney asked on the day of the session to postpone it so counsel could meet the client; the board did not postpone.
allegations.key_passage: While the Board was required to notify Ms. Daley in writing at least 48 hours prior to the executive session, it was not required to accommodate her attorney's scheduling request.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
